texts.SettingsTab:General:InfoBanner: Tenant-wide chat limits and realtime delivery. Defines hard ceilings that apply to every session in this tenant.
texts.SettingsTab:UsagePolicies:InfoBanner: Per-tier session quotas and behavior when limits are reached. Tiers are evaluated by the access mode of each session.
texts.SettingsTab:RateLimits:InfoBanner: Abuse controls for anonymous public chat. Most checks need an IChatUsageGuard (typically Redis) to enforce sliding-window counters.
texts.SettingsTab:AiQuotas:InfoBanner: AI assistant toggles and quota guardrails. Configure assistant routing on the Assistants tab.
texts.SettingsTab:Assistants:InfoBanner: Route inbox assistant entry points to AIManagement workspaces. Use English keys (for example support, kb-copilot) and localized display names. Only assistants marked Public appear in the messenger; internal assistants are referenced by key elsewhere.
texts.SettingsTab:Retention:InfoBanner: Data retention windows for messages, closed sessions and usage records. Confirm with your data-retention policy before lowering values.
texts.SettingsTab:EmailConnector:InfoBanner: Inbound and outbound email channel. Requires the Chat.EmailConnector feature; secrets are encrypted on save.
texts.SettingsGroup:TenantWide:Hint: Applies across every session and participant in this tenant.
texts.SettingsGroup:Realtime:Hint: When disabled, clients fall back to polling and SignalR endpoints stop accepting connections.
texts.SettingsGroup:AiQuotas:Hint: Caps applied per session, per tenant and per anonymous IP. Use 0 to disable the individual cap.
texts.SettingsGroup:AiWorkspace:Hint: Default workspace for generic Start AI Chat when no assistant mapping is chosen. Create or edit workspaces in AIManagement.
texts.SettingsGroup:AssistantMappings:Hint: Tenant-defined assistants mapped to AIManagement workspaces. Enable Public to show an assistant in the messenger inbox; internal-only assistants stay hidden and are referenced by English key elsewhere (operator copilot, KB routing).
texts.AssistantMappings:KeyInvalid: Key must be a lowercase English identifier (a-z, 0-9, hyphen, underscore).
texts.AssistantMappings:KeyDuplicate: An assistant with key '{0}' already exists.
texts.AssistantMappings:Empty: No assistants configured yet. Add rows to expose multiple inbox entry points (for example Support and Sales).
texts.AssistantMappings:Key:Hint: Lowercase English identifier (a-z, 0-9, hyphen, underscore). Example: support
texts.AssistantMappings:Public:Hint: When enabled, users see this assistant in the inbox. When disabled, reference the English key from internal features only.
texts.AssistantMappings:WorkspaceUnhealthy: Selected workspace is missing an API key or is inactive. Users will not see this assistant until the workspace is healthy.
texts.SettingsGroup:EmailInbound:Hint: Account used to poll incoming emails and thread them into chat sessions.
texts.SettingsGroup:EmailSmtp:Hint: Account used to send replies. Different mailbox from inbound is supported.
texts.Tier:PublicAnonymous:Hint: Visitors without an authenticated identity (public chat widget, anonymous public site).
texts.Tier:PublicAuthenticated:Hint: Signed-in end users on public-facing surfaces (customer portal, marketing site).
texts.Tier:Internal:Hint: Internal users (operators, staff, employees) talking through admin or back-office surfaces.
texts.MaxAttachmentBytesPerSession:Hint: Total upload size cap per session in bytes (e.g. 26214400 for 25 MB).
texts.LimitExceededAction:RequireAuthenticatio: Require the visitor to sign in
texts.SignupGate:Hint: Anonymous visitors are prompted to sign in after consuming this many free messages/AI questions.
texts.MessageRetentionDays:Hint: Days to keep individual chat messages after creation. Use 0 to keep forever.
texts.ClosedSessionRetentionDays:Hint: Days to keep a closed session before purging the session and its messages.
texts.UsageRecordRetentionDays:Hint: Days to keep raw usage and quota records used for analytics and audit.
texts.CloseSession:Confirm: Close this chat session? Participants will no longer be able to send new messages.
texts.Usage:InfoBanner: Live counters require Redis-backed IChatUsageGuard. The cards below reflect feature flags and configured per-tier ceilings.
texts.MaxMessagesPerTenantPerDay: Max messages per tenant per day
texts.MaxSessionsPerUserPerDay: Max sessions per user per day
texts.AnonymousRateLimitsHint: These controls apply only to anonymous public chat flows.
texts.MaxSessionsPerIpPerDay: Max sessions per IP per day
texts.MaxMessagesPerIpPerDay: Max messages per IP per day
texts.MaxAiSessionsPerIpPerHour: Max AI sessions per IP per hour
texts.MaxAiQuestionsBeforeSignupRequired: Free AI questions before signup required
texts.MaxTokensPerTenantPerDay: Max tokens per tenant per day
texts.MaxAnonymousAiSessionsPerHour: Max anonymous AI sessions per hour
